gloss: to paste together; to glue together

definitions.gloss: to paste together; to glue (two things) face to face
definitions.explanation: To join two sheets or pieces together by applying adhesive between them, so that their surfaces stick face to face. Common with paper, boards, photos, and layered materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: To paste sheets of paper together.
I glued the two boards together with adhesive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせて、⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧な⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Many thin sheets of wood are glued together to make a strong board.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧ (to stick, paste) + ⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to join together). The ⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ component adds the sense of joining two things to each other.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧).
- Pattern: A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせる / A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせる

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせる: paste papers together
- のり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせる: glue together with paste
